(1)

For purposes of this disclosure, long-lived assets implies hard assets that cannot be readily removed, and thus excludes intangibles. Long-lived assets disclosed above include amounts recorded in

Property, plant and equipment, net and right-of-use assets for operating leases recorded in Other noncurrent assets on the Consolidated Balance Sheets.

(2)

Includes Puerto Rico revenues of $293 million, $311 million, and $298 million for the years ended December 31, 2022, 2021, and 2020, respectively, and long-lived assets of $96 million and $79 million

as of December 31, 2022 and 2021, respectively.

(3)

The Mong Duong II power project is operated under a BOT contract. Future expected payments for the construction performance obligation are recognized in Loan receivable on the Consolidated

Balance Sheets. See Note 20—Revenue for further information.
